lastResponse.text: Thank you for calling. I hear you. Your neighbor is 78, mostly alone, and you’re worried about neglect. I heard that. First, a safety check: is he in immediate danger right now, or needing urgent medical help right now? If yes, call nine one one. That is nine one one. If not immediate, I can help you report suspected neglect in Oregon.
